inputs.name: gameViewFiles.name
inputs.description: The name used to derive the view config's symbol, id, and title. It is case-converted for those generated values, with no additional validation in this function.

inputs.name: gameViewFiles.dimension
inputs.description: The view dimension inserted into the config; a falsy value causes fail to throw ExpectedCliError. The failure message asks for harness.dimension of 2d or 3d, but the function only checks truthiness and does not whitelist those values.

inputs.name: mechanicFiles.name
inputs.description: The mechanic name used to derive its kebab-case file and test id and camelCase function symbol. This function passes it through case-conversion helpers without additional validation.

inputs.name: checkpointFiles.name
inputs.description: The checkpoint name used to derive the config symbol, kebab-case id, and PascalCase title. The function uses case conversion without additional validation.

outputs.name: gameViewFiles
outputs.description: The function returns one planned file at src/configs/<camelCaseName>ViewConfig.ts. Its contents include the converted id and title and supplied dimension, with empty style and checkpoints.

outputs.name: mechanicFiles
outputs.description: The function returns a utility file and a Vitest test file. The generated utility accepts readonly GameState and GameInput and returns an empty patch, while the test checks the named mechanic with a simple input.

outputs.name: checkpointFiles
outputs.description: The function returns one planned file at src/configs/<camelCaseName>CheckpointConfig.ts. It derives id and title from name and initializes description to an empty string, coordinates to zero, and requires, conditions, and actions to empty arrays.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown when dimension is falsy in gameViewFiles; the implementation calls fail with this exact message: 'A game view needs harness.dimension 2d or 3d in package.json.'
